name: Transport Search
author: self-hosted
description: Search buses, trains, flights and transfers between any two places via Traveling.com. Browse results, filter by transport type, and open booking links.

settings.label: Trafiklab (ResRobot) API key
settings.hint: Free key from developer.trafiklab.se — enables supplemental Swedish domestic transit search (all modes, not just trains) when Traveling.com has thin/no coverage. Leave blank to disable.
